dataset: geoBoundaries gbOpen — Saudi Arabia (SAU) ADM1 (13 administrative regions)
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
license_note: The geoBoundaries site states CC BY 4.0 in general, but THIS layer's own metadata says ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap-derived). ODbL is the governing licence for this file.

simplified.modification: None by this project. This is geoBoundaries' own pre-simplified release; the file is stored byte-for-byte as downloaded.

retrieved_by: HTTP download of the release URLs above

validation.method: bloom.geo.validate_geojson plus an offline cross-check of full vs simplified geometry
validation.shapeISO_codes: SA-01..SA-12 and SA-14 exactly (no SA-13 exists in ISO 3166-2:SA)
validation.city_in_region_check: 13 well-known city coordinates (reviewer-supplied, independent of the dataset) each fall in exactly the expected region
validation.area_caveat: Computed total ~1.93M km2 is ~10% below the commonly cited ~2.15M km2 for the Kingdom, consistent with the provider's own statistics (13 x meanAreaSqKM = 1.92M). Boundaries are one OpenStreetMap-based depiction (year represented 2017), not an authoritative survey; they must not be used for legal, cadastral or border-delimitation purposes.
